decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the Big Block pool target, draw trigger, and secondary-royalty contribution; the Small Block changes require no additional candidate update.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already captures the separate ticket counters, issuance, eligibility windows, post-draw resets, and exclusion of secondary-sale tickets.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records the Small and Big Block ticket eligibility windows, and the source does not otherwise change the random ticket-weighted selection method.
The candidate's same-message Event already records that secondary royalties fund both prize pools without creating referral tickets.
The source explicitly leaves manual prize claiming unchanged, so the Small Block pool and trigger modification does not alter the collection flow.
The candidate's same-message Event already captures display of the two ticket counters and permanent badges; the Small Block pool target adds no further metadata requirement.
The source states that random ticket allocation when no referral is used remains identical, so the Small Block pool and draw-trigger changes do not modify this Requirement.
